meta.name: Fool Night
meta.description: In a sunless future where humans become plants to make oxygen, a desperate young man begins the transformation — and unearths a deep-rooted conspiracy.

videos.title: Red Spider Lily
videos.overview: It's been 100 years since the world felt sunlight. Toshiro, fleeing poverty and a violent mother, decides to transflorate his body for 10 million yen.

videos.title: Sapphire Berry
videos.overview: On his first day at Transflora Medical, Toshiro takes on a case: a pianist searching for her father's spiriflor. Her intentions aren't what they seem.

videos.title: Liriope
videos.overview: With anti-transfloration tensions rising and a killer on the loose, Yomiko turns to Toshiro for help. But he's consumed by how little time he has left.

videos.title: Lotus
videos.overview: Toshiro joins the hunt for Ivy, driven by revenge. Meanwhile, a struggling father is drawn into the anti-transfloration movement for his daughter's sake.

videos.title: Uncaria rhynchophylla
videos.overview: Akira and Kanaeno are down. Toshiro braces for death — but Ivy doesn't kill him. Instead, it speaks. "That person took my sister." The voice is a child's.

videos.title: Anemone
videos.overview: Following Ivy's mention of "the Parade," Toshiro ventures into Paupertown — and discovers a ritual of sacrifice designed to keep the system alive.

videos.title: Forget-me-not
videos.overview: Clearing Transflora Medical's name means proving Ivy wasn't part of it. But as Toshiro and Yomiko dig, it becomes harder to believe in the system.

videos.title: Tansy
videos.overview: As Hikasa launches his anti-transfloration party, Yomiko devises a bold ambush to capture one of his men. But will it lead them to the proof they need?

videos.title: Fish Mint
videos.overview: The protests at the Transfloration Board are nearing a breaking point. Yomiko's gamble: forge a document and draw out the mastermind behind Ivy.

videos.title: Gentian
videos.overview: Everything falls apart. Akira is captured, the document seized — and an unexpected face suddenly appears. Meanwhile, Yomiko makes her move.

videos.title: Ivy
videos.overview: Shielding Yomiko in the half-destroyed train, Toshiro makes contact with Ivy and is pulled into the painful memories of the child trapped inside.

videos.title: Passion Flower
videos.overview: As a life-and-death fight rages, Mukuru asks Toshiro for friendship. Meanwhile, Yomiko makes a deal with Kudai and learns the truth behind transfloration.
